headline: The cross-ticker read stays constructive overall, but today still looks selective rather than a broad clean risk-on continuation.

today.thesis: Official evidence remains strong — MLPerf leadership, HPE AI-factory expansion, Coherent optical-capacity buildout, and recent financing flexibility all reinforce the longer AI-infrastructure thesis. But NVDA is still lagging the strongest semicap names in premarket, and Mytutopia RSI 45.4 / VEL5 +4.2 describes a repaired setup, not a confirmed breakout. Base case: rebound / stabilization with room for intraday chop.
drivers: Whether NVDA can hold roughly the $206-$207 zone after the open
Whether strength in semicap peers broadens back into NVDA specifically
Whether financing headlines are treated as optionality rather than overhang

30d.thesis: The business anchor remains strong — Blackwell monetization, networking attach, enterprise / sovereign AI-factory deployment, and deeper full-stack control points. Mytutopia's positive VEL5 is mildly supportive. But the newly worsened 30-day scorecard says the stock can digest great fundamentals for longer than the narrative wants, so this stays constructive with restrained confidence and a wider downside allowance.

90d.thesis: Over a quarter, NVIDIA still looks best positioned to monetize the converging stack of accelerators, networking, agentic software, confidential inference, and large-cluster infrastructure. The MLPerf, HPE, and Coherent updates all support that platform view. Mytutopia is only supplementary here, but the repaired technical regime avoids forcing a bearish overlay.

falsifiers: Meaningful supply-chain bottlenecks

1y.thesis: NVIDIA still has the strongest combined position in silicon leadership, systems / networking integration, software lock-in, and capital-allocation flexibility. The latest benchmark, enterprise, optics, and financing signals reinforce scale ambition rather than stress. Mytutopia's delayed RSI/VEL5 only modestly informs this horizon, but it does not contradict the longer-term constructive case.
